name: leave_workflow
description: Employee leave request processing with manager approval and HR update

steps.name: validation
steps.description: Validate employee, leave type, and date eligibility

steps.name: policy_check
steps.description: Check leave policy, balance, and blackout dates

steps.name: leave_processing
steps.description: Verify leave balance and prepare leave request

steps.name: hr_update
steps.description: Update HR system with approved leave and deduct balance

steps.name: notification
steps.description: Notify employee of leave decision and team calendar update

steps.name: audit
steps.description: Record leave approval in audit trail
